storyTypes.name: Problem-Solution
storyTypes.description: Character wants something, faces obstacle, tries and fails, finally succeeds

storyTypes.name: Fantasy/Dream
storyTypes.description: Character wishes to be something else, transforms, experiences magic, returns to reality
storyTypes.classic: Where the Wild Things Are, Harold and the Purple Crayon

storyTypes.name: Journey/Adventure
storyTypes.description: Character leaves home, travels through places, discovers something, returns changed

storyTypes.name: Slice of Life
storyTypes.description: Simple moments in a day, sensory experiences, gentle observations

storyTypes.name: Cumulative/Pattern
storyTypes.description: Repeating structure that builds, same pattern with variations
storyTypes.classic: Brown Bear Brown Bear, The Very Hungry Caterpillar

storyTypes.name: Friendship
storyTypes.description: Two characters meet, discover differences, work through conflict, become friends
storyTypes.classic: Frog and Toad, George and Martha

storyTypes.name: Overcoming Fear
storyTypes.description: Character faces something scary, avoids it, must confront it, finds courage
storyTypes.classic: The Kissing Hand, There's a Nightmare in My Closet

storyTypes.name: Helping Others
storyTypes.description: Character sees someone in need, decides to help, overcomes challenges to help

storyTypes.name: Discovery/Learning
storyTypes.description: Character wonders about something, explores, experiments, learns
storyTypes.classic: What Do You Do With an Idea?, Ada Twist Scientist

storyTypes.name: Silly Chain
storyTypes.description: One thing leads to another in increasingly absurd consequences
storyTypes.classic: If You Give a Mouse a Cookie, There Was an Old Lady

storyTypes.name: Bedtime/Routine
storyTypes.description: Following a calming routine, winding down, peaceful ending

storyTypes.name: Lost & Found
storyTypes.description: Something precious is lost, character searches, emotional reunion
